0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>A woman with startling blue hair is in search of her son who has disappeared without a trace.

25.original: Search the designated location and follow the azure-haired boy.

26.original: Follow the azure-haired boy and defeat any enemies that threaten him.

48.original: Excuse me, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6127616DFF0473697203>? Have you seen a little boy with hair a similar shade to mine? He's my son, and I can't find him anywhere!

49.original: It all started when I told him we ought to seek refuge in your encampment, and he started wailing and sobbing like I'd never seen. The next thing I knew, he was running hell-for-leather goodness knows where.

50.original: I'm worried he may have left the station altogether, and the streets above are rife with danger! Please, could you find him for me?

51.original: Oh you will? Bless your heart! If I know my son, he's probably tried to return to our house to the north of Palatium Novum. Try there first before anywhere. He'll be easy to recognize I should think, what with the color of his hair and all.

52.original: I will try searching the station again just in case, though I'd bet anything he's gone back to our house near Palatium Novum.

55.original: Mother sent you? Hmph! Tell her I won't go to the enemy's camp─ I'm going home!

56.original: The boy with the sky blue hair has made good his escape. You had best resume your search for this obstreperous youth.

58.original: Once again, the boy with the sky blue hair has taken flight, and will likely be looking over his shoulder for signs of trouble from now on. With a weary sigh, you resume the hunt.

59.original: Follow the boy from a safe distance. The objective will end in failure if you are noticed, or if you fall too far behind.

60.original: Should you fail to complete the objective, you may try again by looking out over this location.

61.original: Attempt to follow the azure-haired boy?

62.original: No... Our home, it was here─right here!

63.original: You again? Leave me alone! I'm staying here to build a new house─bigger and better than the old one!

64.original: The child has escaped your grasp yet again. Though this may be construed as a particularly tiresome endeavor, remember that he is only a child and knows no better. You should find him before he comes to harm.

65.original: Why do you care so much?

66.original: We're enemies, remember? Why are you trying to help me?

68.original: You need help, and I'm offering it.

69.original: How would your mother feel if something were to happen to you?

70.original: <sniffle> I don't care what you say! We don't need your help!

71.original: But Mother's worried. I should go back. To the station.

72.original: I was wondering when I would see you again. I'm happy to report my son has returned. Poor creature... You should have seen him─tears pouring down his little cheeks, crying his apologies to me. I know that you were the one who found him, though he didn't mention a word of it to me.

73.original: I almost couldn't believe my ears when he said he wouldn't mind moving to your camp. He was dead against it only hours ago. What could have happened, I wonder?

74.original: What? He was attacked? By that horrid magitek, you say? Goodness, that must have been quite a shock for my little man. Thank you for coming to his rescue.

75.original: There is a salutary lesson to be gained from all this, though, one that I hope he retains. Do not scorn a proffered hand when one is in need, whether that hand be friend or foe's. At any rate, I thank you for finding him. It's not much, but please, I insist.
